title.en: efg london jazz festival opens at the royal festival hall.
title.de: jazzfestival-auftakt in der royal festival hall.
title.tr: royal festival hall'da caz festivali açılışı.

line.en: the london jazz festival runs until 22 november across more than 60 venues. the opening night is at 19:30 in the royal festival hall; book ahead.
line.de: das london jazz festival läuft bis 22. november an über 60 spielorten. die eröffnung ist um 19:30 uhr in der royal festival hall; früh buchen.
line.tr: london caz festivali 22 kasıma kadar, 60'tan fazla mekânda sürüyor. açılış gecesi 19:30'da royal festival hall'da; biletleri önceden al.

sparks.why: EFG London Jazz Festival runs 13 to 22 Nov 2026 with 60+ venues (Visit London); the opening night at Royal Festival Hall, 7.30pm, comes from one ticket listing (Stereoboard), not checked on the Southbank Centre site.
